_comment: Car-seat stroller adapter fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Bugaboo Butterfly car seat adapter
seatBrandsSupported: Maxi-Cosi interface car seats. Bugaboo lists: Clek Liing; Maxi-Cosi Mico / Mico 30; Nuna Pipa series (Pipa, Lite, Lite LX, RX); Cybex Aton 2 / Aton Q / Cloud Q; Kiddy Evolution Pro2; and Bugaboo Turtle Air / Turtle One by Nuna. Confirms the Clek Liing + Maxi-Cosi footprint.

status.clekNote: Clek Liing is explicitly listed by Bugaboo as compatible with this adapter.

install.pieces: pair of click-and-go adapter brackets (left + right)
install.notes: Bugaboo click-and-go attachment system: brackets clip onto the Butterfly frame and the infant car seat clicks into the adapters; no tools required.

notes: Adapter for the ORIGINAL Bugaboo Butterfly (2022) only — Bugaboo's page and retailers label it 'Butterfly (2022)'. Distinct part from the Butterfly 2 adapter (400018003); the two are not interchangeable. $69.95 MSRP; in stock at Destination Baby & Kids (3 in stock), limited/out of stock on bugaboo.com DTC. Clek Liing explicitly listed as a compatible seat.
